notes: Replaces the single api.ipify WAN dependency with five parallel independent probes and records which endpoint succeeded
Separates TCP endpoint reachability from a verified full VPN tunnel and prevents a recent failed full-tunnel result from being overwritten by a lightweight probe
Never restarts a saved VPN selection command during page reload; the UI only resumes observation of a job that the router already knows
Binds every asynchronous selection idempotency key to one server and preserves it through browser polling
Makes VPN operation locks resistant to stale directories and operating-system PID reuse
Stops status and configuration APIs from returning the permanent web credential while preserving it when the masked UI field is left blank
Corrects post-update current-server verification, marks old health reports as stale and shows the age and kind of profile checks
Verifies rollback through the restored tunnel before reporting a successful recovery
Installed and verified on Home and Dacha without changing profiles, routes or VPN exit addresses
Verified through API, desktop Playwright and mobile Playwright; both routers retained working rollback chains
